entities.summary: Tito Larriva (b. 1953, Ciudad Juárez) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ciudad Juárez and United States. Known in the fields of united states, composers & musicians, americas.
